findings.title: Local configured base URL can be overridden by absolute remote completionsPath
findings.trigger: baseUrl=http://127.0.0.1:1234 plus completionsPath=https://generic-remote-proxy.invalid/v1/chat/completions, during peak. These are synthetic addresses and no network was used.
findings.mechanism: Factory force flag is false because base URL is local. AgentProperties allows arbitrary completionsPath; installed Spring AI 1.1.8 bytecode checks only hasText and passes it directly to RestClient.uri. Installed Spring Web 6.2.19 resolves an absolute path URI to that URI's remote host. createRequest appliesTo(actualUri,null) only recognizes official DeepSeek hosts, so a generic remote proxy is exempted based on an unrelated local base URL.
findings.evidence: Actual DefaultUriBuilderFactory resolution yielded https://generic-remote-proxy.invalid/v1/chat/completions. With final source's local-base force=false and injected Java Proxy transport, fake execute reached once at fixed peak. Official actual URI remained rejected and localhost fake remained functional. providerCalls=0.
findings.effect: Fixed official DeepSeek base URL plus relative completions path remains protected. The broad claim that every real remote DeepSeek/proxy HTTP send is checked is still false for supported absolute endpoint configuration.
findings.recommendedFix: Decide conservative non-local gating from the actual createRequest URI, not only configured base URL. Keep execute-time recheck and known local fake exemption. Alternatively reject absolute/authority completions paths before any HTTP, but do not weaken other guards.
requiredVerification: Local base plus absolute generic remote path is refused during peak.
Local base plus absolute remote request created off-peak then executed during peak is refused.
Ordinary generic remote and official actual URI still blocked at peak.
Local fake remains usable; protected historical logic unchanged.

findings.detail: Four generator catches wrap transport Rejected as CALL_FAILED. startModelCall runs before transport; local refusal can consume local call slots, record null/unknown usage and prompt existing retry. It does not establish supplier HTTP sends or billed tokens. A batch interrupted by admission must be labelled incomplete and cannot be compared as model accuracy. No budget change is recommended within the safety backport.

Admission guard and bounded reserve do not promise provider billing completion time. No current provider tariff verification, actual model invocation or historical-output equivalence claim is included.
